story.title: India's AI Hiring Moves to Skills-First — 2 Million Already Upskilled, Tier 2 Cities Surge
story.summary: India's hiring market is undergoing a structural shift in 2026: employers are moving from degree-first to skills-first, and AI fluency — the ability to use AI to deliver results that once took a team of three — is now the primary filter. Over 2 million Indian professionals have already completed formal AI upskilling. Demand for generative AI and LLM skills surged nearly 60 percent year-on-year. The geographic story is equally significant: while Bengaluru leads with 26 percent of AI roles, Jaipur, Indore, and Mysuru are emerging as genuine AI job hubs, not just Tier 1 overflow. For a fresh graduate in a Tier 2 city, the window to enter a high-demand field with a skills certificate — not a postgraduate degree — has never been more open.
